response.sql: WITH src AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS proj_cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT AVG(proj_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM src), kept AS (SELECT src.ratio, src.proj_cnt, stats.avg_cnt FROM src CROSS JOIN stats WHERE src.proj_cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(proj_cnt) AS total_projects, AVG(proj_cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_count_excess FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each funding source's ratio is the average of boxy/boxz over its matched spatial rows; rows with NULL boxy or NULL boxz are skipped, and boxz = 0 is treated as missing (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero. The 'average of the kept sources' ratios' is the mean of these per-source ratios, one value per source.
Distinct project counts include every matched project in the source, even if its ratio is missing. Only the ratio average ignores missing values.
A NULL fundflux is grouped as one 'missing' source by GROUP BY, and that group is included in the cross-source average and in the keep test.
Only projects with at least one scanspatial row count (inner join). Scanspatial rows whose arcref has no matching project are dropped.
The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of the per-source distinct project counts. The keep test is strictly greater than that average.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is pooled across all individual spatial records in the kept sources (one average over every valid boxy/boxz ratio in those sources), not the average of per-source ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH rec AS (SELECT p.fundflux, p.arcregistry, s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0) AS r FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref), src AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT arcregistry) AS proj_cnt FROM rec GROUP BY fundflux), stats AS (SELECT AVG(proj_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM src), kept AS (SELECT src.fundflux, src.proj_cnt, stats.avg_cnt FROM src CROSS JOIN stats WHERE src.proj_cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT (SELECT AVG(rec.r) FROM rec JOIN kept ON kept.fundflux IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rec.fundflux) AS avg_ratio, (SELECT SUM(proj_cnt) FROM kept) AS total_projects, (SELECT AVG(proj_cnt - avg_cnt) FROM kept) AS avg_count_excess;
